title: Orientation landing hero, interactive step-map, and screenshot pack
text:
Orientation landing hero, interactive step-map, and screenshot pack

description:
Refresh the landing page hero to present a clear orientation path for new users. Deliver a coordinated visual system: a layered hero with modular screenshot cards, an interactive step-map (visual guide to first-run tasks), and a production-ready screenshot pack for docs and release notes. This ticket covers design comps, responsive specs, exported assets, and handoff notes for engineering and docs.

context:
Current quickstart hero feels fragmented across breakpoints and code-led screenshots are out of sync with product UX. We need a singular visual language that communicates the first 3 recommended actions (Create API key, Run sample request, Inspect cost/latency) with minimal copy and strong affordances for click-throughs. This work ties to the onboarding metrics dashboard (activation funnel) and the upcoming docs release runtime-1.20.

goals:
Unify hero visual treatment across desktop/tablet/mobile
Surface a compact interactive "step-map" that illustrates the recommended starter path
Provide a clean screenshot pack (desktop, tablet, phone) with annotated variants for docs and marketing
Ensure assets meet accessibility contrast and alt-text standards
Create handoff-ready Figma file and export recipe for engineering/devs

deliverables:
High-fidelity desktop hero comps (3 variants: default, low-bandwidth, compact)
Responsive comps for tablet and phone
Interactive step-map prototype in Figma (clickable steps, hover states)
Screenshot export pack: device frames, @1x/@2x PNGs, SVGs for diagrams
Asset export manifest and naming convention README
Acceptance checklist and accessibility report

assets:
Hero background illustration (SVG, layered): bg-hero-orientation.svg
Modular screenshot cards (Figma components): card-live, card-console, card-cost
Step-map tokens and microcopy file: stepmap-texts.md
Microinteraction specs (Lottie/JSON placeholder): stepmap-hover.json
Screenshot pack: hero-desktop-2x.png, hero-mobile-2x.png, step-annotated.svg

accessibility_considerations:
Ensure hero CTA contrast >= 4.5:1, step-map uses semantic labels and keyboard focus states, screenshots include descriptive alt text and avoid color-only information. Provide text-only fallback for the interactive map.

responsive_breakpoints:
Desktop >= 1200px, Tablet 768-1199px, Mobile <= 767px. Hero collapses into stacked content on narrow widths; step-map becomes a progressive accordion on mobile.

animation_notes:
Micro-interactions: gentle scale on card hover (1.03x), progress ring animation when step is active (duration 220ms ease-out). Provide non-animating CSS-only fallback and reduced-motion variants.

engineering_dependencies:
ENG-2108: screenshot generation pipeline (needs new device frames)
ENG-2174: hero component accepts layered SVG backgrounds
ENG-2249: analytics event for step-map clicks (activation funnel)

acceptance_criteria:
Figma file signed off by PM and Design reviewer
All export assets present in the docs bucket and follow naming conventions
Desktop and mobile hero implemented in staging with correct breakpoints
Interactive step-map QAed for keyboard + screen reader access
Performance check: hero SVG under 120KB gzipped and page load impact validated
Release notes updated with new screenshot pack and copy snippets

updates:
2026-03-10 — Ticket created by Maya Patel. Initial brief attached and kickoff meeting scheduled.
2026-03-11 — Designer handoff: wireframes complete; started hi-fi exploration for layered background. Noted constraint: current hero component doesn't accept multiple SVG layers; engineering flagged ENG-2174.
2026-03-12 — PM review: prioritized low-bandwidth variant for regionally constrained users. Added accessibility checklist item and export manifest template. Assigned screenshot export responsibility to Docs.
2026-03-12 — Designer update: created interactive step-map prototype in Figma; initial rounds of microcopy drafted. Ready for Design review on 2026-03-14.
